text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash held her own against her 
Senior Year predecessors. It was a tough 
battle, but she could truly feel her own 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two are expected to clash again at the 
Arima Kinen. Confident that she just needs 
to win this time around, she gives an 
assured nod.
